Rashi on Kiddushin 76a:1:1.hebrew: ופוטרין את הנשואות - מן החליצה. ולרבי עקיבא, בני חייבי לאוין ממזרים הם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 76a:1:1.english: And they would exempt married women - From ḥalitza. And according to Rabbi Akiva, the offspring of [those who violate] negative prohibitions are mamzerim.

Rashi on Kiddushin 76a:1:2.hebrew: החוצה - החיצונה, שלא נכנסה עדיין לרשות הבעל לנשואין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 76a:1:2.english: Outside - The outside one, who has not yet entered the husband's domain for marriage.

Rashi on Kiddushin 76a:2:1.english: And [the Gemara] answers: It teaches us [that] there is a mamzer from those liable to karet - And [this is] to exclude [the view of] the one who says (Yevamot 49a) that there is no mamzer except from those liable to court-imposed death.
